README.md.summary: This `README.md` file documents the Paint.NET plugin project, providing installation instructions and usage examples. It serves as the primary user guide for converting images into Minecraft map color palettes.

MinecraftMapColorPalette.cs.summary: `MinecraftMapColorPalette.cs` defines a standard Minecraft color palette array and `AlphaThreshold` UI control for color conversion scripts, serving as the palette data source for the project.

Colors.java.summary: `Colors.java` defines the `Colors` enum, providing standard RGBA color constants used for rendering blocks and materials throughout the project.

extract_colors.py.summary: `extract_colors.py` parses raw color text data to generate RGB/RGBA CSVs, a C# Paint.NET array, and a Java `Colors` enum. It serves as a build-time data conversion utility.

raw_color_page.txt.summary: This data file defines raw color mappings, RGB values, and associated block categories for map rendering. It serves as a reference for color-to-block mapping in the project.

test.py.summary: File `test.py` defines a raw RGB color palette list (`l`) used for testing or configuration. It serves as a static dataset module within the project.
